descriptor: Calendar that plans your week around energy

voice.summary: Kite sounds like a launch teaser from friendly people: light, a touch mysterious and always specific about the date. It promises calm weeks rather than faster ones.
dos: Tease the idea in one sentence, then name the date
Talk about energy and time, not inboxes and tasks
Keep the waitlist ask to a single line
donts: Do not overpromise features that are not built
Never use rocket or hustle metaphors

taglines: Something light is about to take off
Plan the week around your energy
boilerplate: Kite is a calendar that plans your week around your energy rather than your inbox, now opening early access to a waitlist ahead of its launch.

microcopy.success: You are on the list. We will write soon.
microcopy.error: That email does not look right. Please check it.
microcopy.empty: No one has joined yet. Be the first.

logo.note: A diamond reads as a kite shape and stays crisp at small sizes.
